original_card.acceptance_gate: An exact arbitrary-input identity, source/target frame availability and restoration at the chosen cut, plus the complete channel+correction+idle/hosting bill or an explicit favorable bound. The native channel alone is not a supplier. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

actual_scope: Prove that whole idle jobs covering the masks of the chain-nested root cost at least the chain's sum (one-sided jobs, active rank two), prove that every shortest root of the stated form has an all-field and that its three largest target ranks sum to at least 16W+3, check on the literal words that retirement on the chain family and #6726's witnesses is a mask reduction, and compute the best chain shape exactly on the complex and binary histograms.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a source-bound construction. This package is a set of lower bounds, a structural theorem and exact finite searches about an existing word; it builds no new word and claims no kappa.
bottleneck_link: docs/research/research-family-status.md; the paid idle term and the target multiset of the root are two terms of the complete signed invoice of the chain-nested caller.
stop_rule: No kappa claim. Every statement carries its hypotheses; applying one still needs its own complete invoice and the five framework assumptions of the cited words.

open_questions.question: Is there an idle job that spans a left and a right site once it may be conjugated through the other sites it does not commute with, or be non-contiguous or non-idempotent?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Theorem 1 assumes one-sided jobs and the exact check covers only jobs transported through the three thin queries; a spanning job would cut the paid idle term.
open_questions.first_step: Compute the line spaces of the chain root at g = 3 and 4 for every pair of site sets with transport through all intermediate sites, and read the dimensions.
open_questions.blocked_by: A legal definition of a job crossing sites it does not commute with, accepted by the compiler assumption.

open_questions.question: Is every retirement of a shortest root the reduction of one mask?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Only the chain word and #6726's two witnesses are checked; a retirement that is not a mask reduction would not be covered by the mask enumeration.
open_questions.first_step: Derive from the pure dual-pair condition at a cut the eigen-condition on the prefix matrix and test whether removing the pivot from the masks again satisfies the root identity on one root with random masks.
open_questions.blocked_by: A reliable solver for roots with prescribed masks; the numerical solvers tried do not find the eight-field root.

open_questions.question: Does (9|9) stay optimal among roots whose masks are not chain-nested (two all-fields, fields supported on both sides)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Proposition 4 covers only the chain-nested family at 18 stages; Theorem 2 already forces an all-field and a prefix and a suffix field.
open_questions.first_step: Enumerate mask patterns for n = 6 and 8 that satisfy the residual identity of Lemma 3.4 and price each with the ledger.
open_questions.blocked_by: Existence of exact solutions of the rank-one system for each pattern.
